# registry_oidc_group_mapping (Resource)

Manages a single OIDC group → organization role mapping. The backend stores mappings as a full-replace list; this resource reads the current list, adds or removes its entry, and writes the list back.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Each mapping is one entry in the backend's full-replace list. Manage every
# mapping for an organization through this resource so that out-of-band edits
# do not race with Terraform's read-modify-write.
resource "registry_oidc_group_mapping" "platform_admins" {
  group        = "platform-admins"
  organization = registry_organization.example.name
  role         = "admin"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group` (String) OIDC groups claim value to match.
- `organization` (String) Organization name or ID this mapping applies to.
- `role` (String) Role name to assign members of this group.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Composite identifier: {group}:{organization}.
